name: Dragnet
description: Follows the cases of a dedicated Los Angeles police detective, Sergeant Joe Friday, and his partners. The show takes its name from the police term "dragnet", meaning a system of coordinated measures for apprehending criminals or suspects.

videos.title: The Human Bomb
videos.overview: A man walks into City hall carrying a live bomb. He threatens to blow up the building if his brother isn't released from jail.

videos.title: The Big Actor
videos.overview: Friday and Jacobs track down a drug ring through a small-time television actor who is hooked on heroin.

videos.title: The Big Death
videos.overview: Friday poses as a hired killer for a man who wants his wife dead.

videos.title: The Big Mother
videos.overview: A new-born baby is stolen from a hospital nursery and the trail leads the police to a deranged mother.

videos.title: The Big Cast
videos.overview: The police interrogate a suspect whom they believe to have murdered more than a dozen men.

videos.title: The Big Speech
videos.overview: A doctor is beaten and robbed of prescription drugs.

videos.title: The Big Parrot
videos.overview: A couple are robbed and murdered, along with their pet parrot. The killer uses a time bomb to start a fire and cover up his crime.

videos.title: The Big Blast
videos.overview: A divorced mother is killed in bed by a shotgun while her young boy sleeps beside her.

videos.title: The Big Trial
videos.overview: Friday testifies at the trial of a man accused of a hit-and-run, but the main witness against him suddenly disappears.

videos.title: The Big September Man
videos.overview: A secretary is beaten to death and the search for the killer leads police to a religious fanatic.

videos.title: The Big Phone Call
videos.overview: Friday confronts a jeweler with tape recorded evidence that proves he hired someone to rob his own store.

videos.title: The Big Casing
videos.overview: A man claims that his wife committed suicide right in front of him, but the evidence suggests otherwise.

videos.title: The Big Lamp
videos.overview: Friday and Jacobs are out to catch a safe burglar who has been on the loose for seven months.

videos.title: The Big Jump
videos.overview: A man stands upon the ledge of a tall building and threatens to jump to his death below.

videos.title: The Big Sorrow
videos.overview: Friday must cope with the sudden death of his partner as he and his new partner track a pair of escaped convicts.

videos.title: The Big Elevator
videos.overview: Friday and Smith search for the person who left a dead woman in a hospital elevator.

videos.title: The Big Seventeen
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a group of teenagers who are using and selling drugs.

videos.title: The Big Trio
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate three traffic accidents in one night.

videos.title: The Big Imposter
videos.overview: A missing young boy is found and returned to his grandfather, but the case gets complicated when the grandfather suspects that the boy is not his own grandson.

videos.title: The Big .22 Rifle for Christmas
videos.overview: Two small boys are missing, there are blood stains on the ground and a gun meant as a Christmas present is gone.

videos.title: The Big Cop
videos.overview: Friday has to catch a bad cop who has been dealing with the mob.

videos.title: The Big Grandma
videos.overview: An elderly woman is passing bad checks, but no one suspects her because she looks harmless.

videos.title: The Big Whiff
videos.overview: A woman is murdered when she is given an overdose of chloroform.

videos.title: The Big Show
videos.overview: A seven-week-old baby is found abandoned in a bus station.

videos.title: The Big Safe
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are investigating a missing office safe.

videos.title: The Big Church
videos.overview: A woman receives threatening letters from an unknown stalker.

videos.title: The Big Hate
videos.overview: Gordon Miller, a young pianist, is found near an abandoned freight car holding the dead body of a woman in his arms. He claims he has killed her.

videos.title: The Big Shakedown
videos.overview: Friday is looking for a crooked cop.

videos.title: The Big Rose
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are looking for a missing woman that left her three children with her sister.

videos.title: The Big Building
videos.overview: A prominent dentist denies that his wife is missing, but Friday and Smith can find no trace of her.

videos.title: The Big Run
videos.overview: Two elderly women are struck down by a hit-and-run driver.

videos.title: The Big Break
videos.overview: Friday and Smith track down an escaped convict who is armed and dangerous.

videos.title: The Big Light
videos.overview: Friday and Smith must decide between accident or murder when a crewman working on a movie set is killed by a falling light.

videos.title: The Big Waiter
videos.overview: An immigrant is brutally beaten to death and the trail may lead to the victim's abused wife.

videos.title: The Big Test
videos.overview: A young man reports that he was robbed by bandits on horseback while he was down in Mexico.

videos.title: The Big Lay-Out
videos.overview: A friend of Friday's asks him for help when he discovers that his son has been using drugs, and may be selling them as well.

videos.title: The Big Fire
videos.overview: A land lord begins threatening his tenants so he can force them to move out of his building.

videos.title: The Big Ray
videos.overview: A man suddenly becomes ill and dies after eating his dinner at home.

videos.title: The Big Frank
videos.overview: While investigating a routine robbery with Friday, Smith suffers a critical gunshot wound. Sergeant Friday is out for vengeance.

videos.title: The Big Lease
videos.overview: An elderly widower is missing, so Friday and Smith retrace his actions before his disappearance. Things point to a long vacation until the story of Mrs. Banner, who rented the man's house, doesn't add up.

videos.title: The Big Hands
videos.overview: Friday and Smith suspect a psycho killer when they find a woman with a broken neck in a hotel room.

videos.title: The Big Fourth
videos.overview: Several babies are stolen in the city.

videos.title: The Big Market
videos.overview: A bandit starts robbing people at local markets.

videos.title: The Big Friend
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are torn between two suspects when a man reports that his wife has been strangled.

videos.title: The Big Barrette
videos.overview: Friday and Smith search for the brutal killer of a 21-year-old woman.

videos.title: The Big Dance
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are looking for two thugs that seem to have disappeared from the city.

videos.title: The Big White Rat
videos.overview: Friday and Smith respond to and investigate reports of a drug ring.

videos.title: The Big Revolt
videos.overview: A woman reports her husband missing and Friday and Smith are assigned to find him.

videos.title: The Big Bull
videos.overview: Smith takes a personal interest when a strong-arm bandit threatens his family if he doesn't back off the case.

videos.title: The Big Betty
videos.overview: Friday and Smith track down a confidence ring who are selling defective watches.

videos.title: The Big Sophomore
videos.overview: A teenage boy steals food for his starving family.

videos.title: The Big Pill
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are on the trail of a gang that is robbing local drugstores.

videos.title: The Big Fake
videos.overview: A police rookie is accused of assaulting a citizen and stealing his money.

videos.title: The Big Dream
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate the murder of a girl who came to Los Angeles with a dream of being an actress.

videos.title: The Big Guilt
videos.overview: A man is found dead in an alley and it's up to Friday and Smith to find his killer and notify the man's wife.

videos.title: The Big Will
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate the murder of a rich man.

videos.title: The Big In-Laws
videos.overview: Friday and Smith try to capture a ring of truck hijackers.

videos.title: The Big Kill
videos.overview: A cop is gunned down at home by a vengeful ex con. Friday must go under cover in prison to obtain a full confession.

videos.title: The Big Lover
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a con man that marries rich women just for their money.

videos.title: The Big Thief
videos.overview: Robbers phone doctors for house calls then assault them and steal their drugs.

videos.title: The Big Little Jesus
videos.overview: A statue of the Child Jesus is stolen from a church. Friday and Smith must find it before the paritioners miss it on Christmas morning.

videos.title: The Big Eavesdrop
videos.overview: Friday and Smith overhear a suspicious conversation while on a coffee break in a diner.

videos.title: The Big Trunk
videos.overview: Three men are taken into custody for the murder of a former vaudeville actress who owned a large steamer trunk. The three men maintain innocence.

videos.title: The Big Youngster
videos.overview: Friday and Smith catch a boy who has been vandalising private property, but they discover that the boy's problems begin at home.

videos.title: The Big Boys
videos.overview: The cops must stake out a hotel lobby and deal with a drunken desk clerk as they wait for four juvenile armed robbers to show up.

videos.title: The Big Ham
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate the death of a young girl that is initially ruled a suicide but turns out to be murder.

videos.title: The Big Chance
videos.overview: Signs point to foul play when a highway patrolman disappears from his car along a deserted road.

videos.title: The Big Children
videos.overview: Three children are found abandoned, filthy and starving. Friday and Smith charge the mother with neglect.

videos.title: The Big Poison
videos.overview: An elderly couple suddenly disappears from a fashionable neighborhood.

videos.title: The Big Quack
videos.overview: A man posing as a doctor burgles the house of a woman who is mentally disturbed.

videos.title: The Big Winchester
videos.overview: An elderly man appears to have killed himself with a rifle, but the cops soon learn that it was no accident.

videos.title: The Big Shoplift
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are surprised to find a wealthy house wife is a shoplifter, until they discover that she is a kleptomaniac.

videos.title: The Big Hit-Run Killer
videos.overview: A woman and her grandson are run down by a bakery truck, but the driver has an airtight alibi.

videos.title: The Big Girl
videos.overview: Friday and Smith hunt down the bandit queen; a tall, gorgeous woman who is on a rampage of robberies and shootings.

videos.title: The Big Mattress
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a corrupt cop.

videos.title: The Big Pug
videos.overview: An elderly woman is badly beaten and robbed while on her way to the bank. The trail leads to an ex prize fighter.

videos.title: The Big Frame
videos.overview: A man's body is found in the gutter and the only clue is a pair of skid marks found nearby.

videos.title: The Big Plant
videos.overview: A woman disappears and her husband is the prime suspect, but Friday and Smith will have a hard time getting past his fierce guard dogs.

videos.title: The Big Check
videos.overview: A check forger is victimizing small businessmen in a particular neighborhood.

videos.title: The Big Threat
videos.overview: A man is beaten and robbed, then the thieves intimidate him and his family so he'll refuse to testify against them.

videos.title: The Big Dare
videos.overview: A single mother is stabbed to death in her home. The list of suspects includes her teenage son and her many boyfriends.

videos.title: The Big False Make
videos.overview: Friday begins to question a local gardener, who has been arrested for holding up a grocery store. During the interrogation Friday begins to have strong doubts about the man's confession.

videos.title: The Big Producer
videos.overview: A man claims to be a big Hollywood producer, but Friday and Smith discover that he's merely the leader of a pornography ring.

videos.title: The Big Fraud
videos.overview: A group of con artists are posing as cops and victimizing out-of-town businessmen in fashionable hotels.

videos.title: The Big Crime
videos.overview: Four-year-old twin girls are abducted from the local park.

videos.title: The Big Pair
videos.overview: An old man and his granddaughter are burglarized, leaving them broke and starving.

videos.title: The Big Escape
videos.overview: A case hits too close to home for Friday when his old army buddy robs a liquor store and shoots his partner. Friday believes his friend wants to go straight after doing time, but things get worse when his friend breaks jail.

videos.title: The Big Kid
videos.overview: When Friday and Smith learn that a showdown between two teenage gangs is about to take place within 48 hours, they do their utmost to prevent it.

videos.title: The Big Missing
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are looking for a missing businessman.

videos.title: The Big Bar
videos.overview: A holdup man is sticking up bars. After he takes the money he kills many of his victims. Sergeant Friday has few leads other than that the holdup man likes a certain song on the jukebox.

videos.title: The Big Present
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are looking for a burglar who leaves a milk bottle at the scene of the crime. They suspect a juvenile might be involved.

videos.title: The Big Gangster (Part 1)
videos.overview: An attempt is made on the life of a gang leader. Friday and Smith must find the shooters before his followers seek revenge.

videos.title: The Big Gangster (Part 2)
videos.overview: Friday and Smith must find the men who murdered a gang boss before an open gang war starts.

videos.title: The Big New Years
videos.overview: On New Year's Eve, Friday and Smith are working out of Central Receiving Hospital.

videos.title: The Big Want Ad
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a man who is conning people by using the want ads.

videos.title: The Big Affair
videos.overview: Friday and Smith discover that the key to finding a hold-up artist lies in his married girlfriend.

videos.title: The Big Bible
videos.overview: A man locks himself in his study and threatens suicide if his wife leaves him.

videos.title: The Big Bindle
videos.overview: Friday goes under cover to bust a drug ring that is operating out of a high-class hotel.

videos.title: The Big Office
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are assigned to the business office, where they must deal with the paperwork on a busy weekend.

videos.title: The Big Rod
videos.overview: An expectant mother is run down and killed by two teenagers in a hot rod.

videos.title: The Big Rescue
videos.overview: A group of bandits arm themselves and break their comrades out of jail.

videos.title: The Big Family
videos.overview: Local businessman John Keith Jarrett disappears and evidence of suicide is discovered. Friday and Smith check on the surviving members of his family and find them not the least concerned about their father's death, with his son a tennis bum, his daughter promiscuous, and his wife drunken. The case gets even murkier when a report comes in of a traffic incident upstate involving a camper in which the driver was using Jarrett's license.

videos.title: The Big Shock
videos.overview: Friday and Smith go after a burglar who plans to break into a bank through an underground tunnel.

videos.title: The Big Screen
videos.overview: Friday and Smith team up with a newspaper reporter so they can investigate television repairmen who may be overcharging their customers.

videos.title: The Big TV
videos.overview: The detectives search for a missing mother and child at the behest of her mother-in-law, unaware that the girl's husband has died in action and is not overseas as the woman had claimed.

videos.title: The Big Dog
videos.overview: An old man sits on his front porch with a shotgun, threatening to kill the man who poisoned his dog.

videos.title: The Big Underground
videos.overview: Friday and Smith use a stolen check as a lead to a series of used car lot robberies.

videos.title: The Big Key
videos.overview: A woman's badly mutilated body is found in a churchyard on Christmas eve. The only clue is a key lying under her.

videos.title: The Big Mailman
videos.overview: Friday and Smith go after a bandit who is robbing mailboxes and then trying to cash other people's checks.

videos.title: The Big Tar Baby
videos.overview: A bartender's wife is kidnapped, beaten and rolled in hot tar.

videos.title: The Big Number
videos.overview: Friday and Smith Investigate a Bank Robbery, but they don't have much to go on.

videos.title: The Big Mask
videos.overview: A masked bandit is holding up supermarkets and the police are not able to catch him.

videos.title: The Big Sucker
videos.overview: A con artist is swindling jewelers using fake diamonds.

videos.title: The Big Moustache
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate the robbery of an appliance store.

videos.title: The Big Heel
videos.overview: Friday and Smith use an unusual footprint to help solve a murder case.

videos.title: The Big Gone
videos.overview: The owner of a flower shop kills a man who is trying to rob him, but the corpse mysteriously vanishes.

videos.title: The Big Student
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are on the trail of a bunch of teenagers selling fake magazine subscriptions.

videos.title: The Big Watch
videos.overview: Bandits are offering rides to hitch-hiking soldiers, then robbing and beating them.

videos.title: The Big Dig
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are looking into a report of a missing woman that turns into a murder investigation.

videos.title: The Big Mug
videos.overview: Two hold-up men are robbing and beating pedestrians in the down town area.

videos.title: The Big Pipe
videos.overview: A young woman is beaten to death with a led pipe and left in an empty office.

videos.title: The Big Lift
videos.overview: An organized gang of shoplifters is looting large department stores in the city.

videos.title: The Big Confession
videos.overview: A man walks into the station and tells Friday that he wants to confess to a murder, but the cops have a hard time varifying his story.

videos.title: The Big Gap
videos.overview: A pawn shop owner alerts Friday and Smith when a man claimed to have purchased an expensive ring that turns out to be junk and then asked the pawn shop owner to sell him a gun.

videos.title: The Big Look
videos.overview: A woman is dragged from her home and badly beaten by an unknown attacker.

videos.title: The Big Glasses
videos.overview: A housewife, Ella Ryburn, reports to Friday and Smith that she cannot contact her mother, who is married to Alfred Rudolph Shroder. When he is questioned, Shroder claims his wife left him and that, out of shame, he sold their house and put her items in storage.

videos.title: The Big Bird
videos.overview: Sgt. Friday investigates a robber who only targets pet stores and homes that have pet birds.

videos.title: The Big Laugh
videos.overview: A con man makes lonely women fall for his charms, then steals their money and disappears.

videos.title: The Big Smoke
videos.overview: An elderly couple is brutally beaten and the trail leads police to a former handy man.

videos.title: The Big Bounce
videos.overview: Joe Friday searches for a check forger who has been using the name of the old-time movie villain Parker Allington... who died three years ago.

videos.title: The Big Shot
videos.overview: A night club owner is shot down and there are no witnesses to the crime.

videos.title: The Big Locker
videos.overview: Friday and Smith happen to catch a man trying to sell a stolen ring at a pawn shop.

videos.title: The Big Note
videos.overview: An anonymous note leads Friday and Smith to a group of teenage drug users and their neglectful parents.

videos.title: The Big Genius
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate what seems to be the perfect crime.

videos.title: The Big Reminisce
videos.overview: During a quiet New Year's shift, Friday and Smith remember some of their past cases and why it is they became cops.

videos.title: The Big Sisters
videos.overview: An elderly woman fakes a burglary report so she can get attention from the police and the media.

videos.title: The Big Fall Guy
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are on the trail of a robbery suspect that has robbed two stores.

videos.title: The Big Set
videos.overview: A city councilman is beaten and robbed by two men outside a bar. When he dies from his injuries, Friday and Smith feel pressure to find the killers.

videos.title: The Big Child
videos.overview: A two-year-old child after drinking bleach from under the sink. Friday and Smith are unable to locate the mother for questioning.

videos.title: The Big Slug
videos.overview: A liquor store owner is shot and killed during a botched robbery, but police can find no trace of the fatal bullet.

videos.title: The Big Daughter
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a missing persons report.

videos.title: The Big No Suicide
videos.overview: Friday gets a call from a former mental patient who is threatening to kill himself and his family.

videos.title: The Big Siege
videos.overview: Police find themselves in a stand-off when an armed bank robber takes a woman hostage in her home.

videos.title: The Big Revision
videos.overview: Friday and Smith hit a blank wall when a burglary suspect refuses to admit where he hid his stash.

videos.title: The Big Ex-Blonde
videos.overview: Friday goes undercover to catch brothers who steal people's money by posing as real-estate agents.

videos.title: The Big Bobo
videos.overview: A police officer is suspended from duty when he is accused of taking a bribe in exchange for a prisoner's release.

videos.title: The Big Rush
videos.overview: Two bandits turn cop killer when they gun down an off-duty policeman during a tavern hold-up.

videos.title: The Big Setup
videos.overview: An informant tips off police to a shipment of heroin coming into the country. Friday goes under cover to bust open the ring.

videos.title: The Big Deal
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are investigating a rash of car thefts. The stolen cars are being sold with forged pink slips.

videos.title: The Big Wish
videos.overview: A teenage boy turns himself in and confesses to being an addict, but he refuses to give up the names of his friends who supplied him.

videos.title: The Big Hat
videos.overview: A young man is found hiding in an empty train car with the strangled body of an older woman next to him.

videos.title: The Big Cat
videos.overview: A circus man reports that a tiger escaped from his truck and is now on the loose in Los Angeles.

videos.title: The Big Misses
videos.overview: A frightened wife tells Friday and Smith that she's worried her husband is planning to pull a hold-up.

videos.title: The Big Net
videos.overview: A group of police women act as decoys to draw a stick-up man out into the open.

videos.title: The Big Convertable
videos.overview: A man forges checks to keep himself and his wife in an expensive lifestyle, but he goes too far when he buys a slick convertable.

videos.title: The Big Limp
videos.overview: A teenage boy under arrest admits to police that his brother is planning to rob a loan company.

videos.title: The Big Tattoo
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are looking for a robber with an unusual tattoo.

videos.title: The Big Odd
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a gambling racket.

videos.title: The Big Bill
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate reports of counterfeit money appearing all over the city.

videos.title: The Big Search
videos.overview: A distraught father reports that his teenage daughter is missing, and things look more bleak when her murdered pet is discovered in her room.

videos.title: The Big Talk
videos.overview: A watch salesman reports that he was robbed by two men whom he drank with the night before.

videos.title: The Big Father
videos.overview: A father works as a day burglar so he can buy presents for his kids, now living with his ex wife.

videos.title: The Big Steal
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a rash of burglaries.

videos.title: The Big Manikin
videos.overview: A woman reports that her husband has failed to come home after going out with is business partner.

videos.title: The Big No Tooth
videos.overview: A bandit carrying a sawed-off shotgun is robbing hotels in the down town area.

videos.title: The Big Skip
videos.overview: A man is reported missing, by two different women, the description matches, but the names are different. He is married to these two and has apparently skipped out on both. Friday searches for him at various places.

videos.title: The Big Fin
videos.overview: A tourist leaves her purse in the back of a cab and it's up to Friday and Smith to track it down.

videos.title: The Big Coins
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are on the trail of a robber/arsonist that takes nothing of value and then sets the house on fire.

videos.title: The Big Close
videos.overview: Friday and Smith reopen a closed case because a tip leads them to believe they have the wrong person.

videos.title: The Big Tie
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate the former employee of a tie manufacturing company.

videos.title: The Big Cup
videos.overview: A howling dog leads to the unearthing of the battered body of an old woman in her garden.

videos.title: The Big Truck
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate the hit and run of a little girl.

videos.title: The Big Saint
videos.overview: Friday and Smith try to prove that a salvage yard operator is using his business to fix up stolen cars.

videos.title: The Big Match
videos.overview: An auction house is held up and the only clue to the bandits lies in a dropped matchbook.

videos.title: The Big Celebration
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are on the trail of a thief whose victims are attending weddings and funerals.

videos.title: The Big Lesson
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are on the trail of three masked men responsible for over thirty robberies.

videos.title: The Big Make
videos.overview: A bakery owner and his daughter are shot down during a robbery.

videos.title: The Big Dip
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate money being taken from a department store's registers with the help of store security.

videos.title: The Big Blank
videos.overview: A bunch of forged checks are popping up all over the city and it's up to Friday and Smith to catch the forger.

videos.title: The Big Love
videos.overview: A man reports that his wife ran off with his little girl and the man she was having an affair with. The trail leads Friday and Smith to a suicide pact.

videos.title: The Big Prescription
videos.overview: Mrs. Eileen Multon picks up the wrong prescription. Now it's up to Friday and Smith to find her before it's too late.

videos.title: The Big Jade
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a series of jade robberies.

videos.title: The Big Lip
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are on the trail of a hit-and-run driver.

videos.title: The Big Boot
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a home invasion and their only clue is a boot print in the mud by a window.

videos.title: The Big Rip
videos.overview: A man accuses his son of stabbing him, but Friday and Smith find out that his son has an airtight alibi.

videos.title: The Big Organizer
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are trying to bring down a street gang but are having a hard time getting to the top man known as The Organizer.

videos.title: The Big Gent
videos.overview: An ex con called The Gentleman Bandit begins working again when he holds up a bank with two helpers.

videos.title: The Big Wardrobe
videos.overview: Friday and Smith track a man who writes bad checks for expensive clothes and then sells the clothes for a profit.

videos.title: The Big War
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a report of a teen gang war in the middle of Los Angeles.

videos.title: The Big Evans
videos.overview: A man reports that a police officer blackmailed him for money and then beat him up, and he has the bruises to prove his story.

videos.title: The Big Honeymoon
videos.overview: Friday and Smith are looking for a man who sells fake honeymoon trips to unsuspecting couples.

videos.title: The Big Cracker Box
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a rash of supermarket robberies, and the burglar's calling card is leaving crackers scattered all over the floor of the store.

videos.title: The Big Perfume Bottle
videos.overview: A unique and costly perfume bottle is taken from an upscale home and it's up to Friday and Smith to get it back.

videos.title: The Big Ruthie
videos.overview: A disgruntled ex-con helps Friday and Smith take down a forgery ring that has cashed thousands of dollars in forged payroll checks.

videos.title: The Big Grifter
videos.overview: A con artist operating in the gentle swindle steals money from grieving relatives after their loved ones die.

videos.title: The Big Irony
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a murder-suicide of a husband and wife.

videos.title: The Big Beating
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a woman's claim that her neighbors are abusing their child.

videos.title: The Big Sweet Annie
videos.overview: Friday investigates a woman's disappearance after a convicted murderer is paroled into her custody.

videos.title: The Big Star
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate anonymous threats to disfigure a a famous actress.

videos.title: The Big Oskar
videos.overview: The detectives take a report of valuables stolen from the home of a somewhat eccentric old lady. They begin to suspect something is amiss when she starts talking about how she gets the "scoop" on crimes by being the first to report them to the local newspaper.

videos.title: The Big Little Boy
videos.overview: The detectives are trying to solve the case of the milk bottle bandit when they catch a break and apprehend a diminutive fifteen year old.

videos.title: The Big Voice
videos.overview: A mysterious telephone caller offers a man $1000 for a contract killing, and Friday must identify the caller before it's too late.

videos.title: The Big Jukebox
videos.overview: Friday goes undercover as a bar owner in order to break up an illegal jukebox operation.

videos.title: The Big Doll
videos.overview: As Friday and Smith investigate a woman's death, they are disturbed to find that her daughter is more interested in discussing her collection of dolls.

videos.title: The Big Border
videos.overview: Friday and Smith must track a pair of escaped convicts across the Mexican border.

videos.title: The Big Nazi
videos.overview: While investigating reports of teenagers involved in a gunfight, Friday and Smith are shocked to find one of the teens involved wearing a Nazi uniform.

videos.title: The Big Hot Rod
videos.overview: Friday is on the hunt for a group of teens that are stealing sports cars.

videos.title: The Big Green Monkey
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a robbery, and their only clue to the suspect's identity is a green jade monkey.

videos.title: The Big Hype
videos.overview: Friday attempts to track down a heroin pusher.

videos.title: The Big Maria
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate the death of a woman found murdered in a churchyard on Christmas Eve.

videos.title: The Big Donation
videos.overview: Two con artists are selling phony magazines subscriptions to unsuspecting suckers.

videos.title: The Big Malcolm
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a criminal gang that preys on all-night restaurants.

videos.title: The Big Smart Girl
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a series of robberies in fashionable homes.

videos.title: The Big Doctor
videos.overview: Friday goes undercover to investigate a bookie operation.

videos.title: The Big Signet
videos.overview: Friday and Smith have to find a man selling forged passports and paperwork.

videos.title: The Big Accident
videos.overview: An insurance adjuster files a report with Friday about possible fraudulent insurance claims.

videos.title: The Big Mailman
videos.overview: Friday works with a postal inspector to catch a gang using the mail to scam money from people.

videos.title: The Big Thirteen
videos.overview: An elderly man reports a loss of money to the LAPD, then subsequently denies making the report. Friday and Smith must investigate.

videos.title: The Big Sour
videos.overview: An elderly couple are beaten and robbed. The key to finding the bandits lies in a paper boy and an alert bartender.

videos.title: The Big Starlet
videos.overview: Friday investigates a young starlet under suspicion of check forgery.

videos.title: The Big Holdup
videos.overview: A robber called "The Rattlesnake Bandit" takes pleasure in beating and shooting his victims after he takes their money.

videos.title: The Big Name
videos.overview: The only clue to a murder investigated by Friday is the tape on a knife handle.

videos.title: The Big Couple
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a husband and wife con team that have a long criminal record.

videos.title: The Big Squeeze
videos.overview: Friday investigates a robbery that is caused by a blackmail victim's refusal to pay.

videos.title: The Big Picture
videos.overview: A young girl commits suicide after she is tricked by a pair of movie talent scouts who are really operating a prostitution ring.

videos.title: The Big Carnation
videos.overview: Friday and Smith hunt "The Carnation Kid," a suspect in a series of hotel burglaries.

videos.title: The Big Operator
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a the death of a woman found beaten in her car, and suspect that her husband is somehow involved.

videos.title: The Big Bray
videos.overview: Friday and Smith investigate a series of food market robberies, where the bandit has been posing as a salesman.

videos.title: The Big Infant
videos.overview: Friday and Smith's investigation of a stolen car - containing a sleeping baby - leads them to two juvenile suspects.

videos.title: The Big Appetite
videos.overview: Friday and Smith track a burglar who breaks into homes and businesses to steal gourmet food items.

videos.title: The Big .38
videos.overview: Cab drivers are being held up, but the descriptions given by the victims don't match.

videos.title: The Big Byron
videos.overview: A man reports that his fiance's former boyfriend has taken shots at him.

videos.title: The Big Counterfeit
videos.overview: A man impersonating a police officer is going to local businesses and asking for donations for the widows and orphans fund. Smith and Friday set out to stop the con man.

videos.title: The Big Red
videos.overview: An informant's tip puts Friday on the trail of a narcotics ring.

awards: Won 5 Primetime Emmys. 9 wins & 12 nominations total
